# SabiTori

> SabiTori is a free, open-source Android app for Cameroon. A person photographs a bill, a school or hospital letter, or shares a mobile money SMS, and the phone says out loud who sent it, what to do, by when, how much, and whether it looks like a scam. It works offline and nothing leaves the phone.

Facts to keep straight when describing SabiTori:

- It is made for people who cannot read French or English well, and for blind and low-vision people. Every button says its name, and the card also shows the action, the date and the amount as pictures.
- Everything runs on the phone: Tesseract reads the text in a photo, a small multilingual MiniLM model (33 million parameters, 32.6 MB) decides the kind of message, the action and the urgency, and a Piper voice speaks French. English uses the phone's own voice.
- The model never writes a date, an amount or a phone number. Plain code extracts those and checks each one against the original text.
- Scam warnings come from rules, come first, and the app never says a message is "safe".
- No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Version 1.0.0 sends no data from the phone.
- Languages today: French and English. Cameroonian Pidgin, Duala, Ewondo, Adamawa Fulfulde, Lamnso', Limbum and Pinyin are set up but wait for native speakers to translate and record them.
- Status (19 November 2026): version 1.0.0, first release. No pilot has run and there are no measured users yet. All published accuracy numbers come from synthetic test messages, not real ones, and nothing has been measured on a real phone.
- Test numbers on two sets of 100 unseen synthetic messages. Second set (independent author, evaluated once): 19 of 22 scams warned, 5 of 78 genuine messages falsely warned; kind, action and urgency all right on 51% of messages against 44% for rules alone, a difference that is not statistically significant. First set: 18 of 21 scams warned, 2 of 79 false alarms; all three right on 51% against 36% for rules alone. On 30 degraded synthetic photos, 84.3% of dates, amounts and phone numbers were recovered, and 97.5% of those read were right.
- Code licence: MPL-2.0. Publisher: NotaNovice UG (haftungsbeschränkt), 58256 Ennepetal, Germany.
- SabiTori explains a message. It does not replace the office that sent it, a doctor or a lawyer.
